description:
FEATURES

  • Best material: The quilt is made of premium polyester cover combine high quality cotton. This ultra-soft, reversible blanket is the perfect choice for curling up on the couch, relaxing under the stars, or taking a well-deserved nap.
  • Fabric: 95% Polyester  + 5% Cotton
  • GSM: Approximately 270g/m2
  • Perfect Experience: Good quality for your skin and health sleep. Excellent performance with no skin irritation, hygroscopic, ventilative, anti-static. Beside, with unique design, our quilt will bring customer distinct and luxury experiences. Beautiful color, vibrant printing, even after washing. 100% superior microfiber polyester helps save your time with quick-drying and wrinkle-resistant features
  • Widely Usage:These quilts are great for a picnic at the park, snuggling while watching TV, relaxing on the sofa, or as a stylish bedspread. Also great as a gift for friend or family. The quilt offers all-season usability and a cozy yet breathable construction. 
  • Gift of Love: A perfect idea if you are finding a birthday gift, a housewarming gift, a festival gift, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Valentine’s Day, Christmas gift for your family members, friends, coworkers, roommates. A wonderful way to honor the memory of a special person or milestone.
  • Garment Care: Machine wash or hand wash. Tumble dry on low heat. Avoid direct heat. Do not use bleach.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 5 – 7 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Quilt

 

NOTE:
 

  • Black/white quilt borders are available and will be processed based on the attached mockup or the design’s base color.
  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
